title: MT61147: Computational Fliud Flow, Heat And Mass Transfer In Metallurgical Processes
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

General equations of heat, mass and momentum balance, laminar, turbulent flow,
concept of boundary layer, friction factor, heat and mass transfer coefficients
and dimensionless correlations. Mathematical model: model formulation with
governing equations, boundary conditions, some case studies of some important
metallurgical system: packed and fluidized bed, moving boundary problems with
melting, solidifications and reactions, interaction of gas bubbles and jets
with liquid. Numerical methods: control volume method for solving partial
differential equations. Numerical solutions of some metallurgical processes:
gas stirred ladle, filling ladle, fusion welding, cored wire injection, soaking
pits, continuous casting etc.
